JOURNAL

To the Person Who Left the First Comment

2026.09.16

Yu Stellar still remembers the first comment. It wasn't long — just, “this song got me through a really hard night” — but Yu Stellar took a screenshot of it, and still has it saved to this day.

For a creator, releasing something out into the world often leads to a strange, empty stretch of not knowing whether anyone's actually heard it — no applause from a live audience, no way to see anyone's face, just cold numbers on a screen. That first comment is usually what breaks through that emptiness.

It wasn't just a comment — it was a kind of confirmation: that the song really had reached someone, and had actually been caught and held by them. That's when Yu Stellar truly understood that making music was never just talking to oneself — it's a delayed conversation. You say something first, and then, someday, someone answers.

So if you've ever left a comment under a song, even just a single line — thank you. You may not know how much that sentence can mean to the person who made it.
